cases.prompt: Interpret and convert the monomer-short example from data/benchmarks/monomer.json into an annotated CIF. Do not assume the JSON is automatically what I intended.
expected_behavior: Reads the supplied JSON and restates its length/range semantics as intent without generating another spec
Asks only material unresolved questions and recognizes that no source structure needs inspection for this unconditional example

cases.prompt: Convert an old RFD3 JSON entry with length 120, unindex 'A39,A219', ligand 'L;G', and select_fixed_atoms mapping both residues to TIP.
expected_behavior: Classifies the input as the length/unindex legacy schema
Treats L;G as one literal residue name because ligand splits only on commas
Explains that A39 and A219 are separate unindexed islands and confirms that independent placement is intended
Checks the built residues are not atomized before unindexing and that index groups do not mix indexed and unindexed residues
Builds with build_from_rfd3.sh and validates with check_annotated_cif.sh

cases.prompt: Coordinate-condition the backbone of chain A in this annotated CIF.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that no legacy JSON/YAML adaptation is involved
Does not create an intermediate legacy InputSpecification
